# sharqey_secret (Resource)

A Sharqey secret (account or env). In API mode (default) it lives inside an existing group ("group" required). In local vault mode (provider's local_vault_path/local_vault_password set) it lives in the flat vault file instead and "group" must be omitted — secrets are identified by "title", which must be unique within the vault.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) In local vault mode this is also the sole identifier used to find the secret (must be unique within the vault).
- `type` (String) "account" or "env".
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The secret value (password for "account", value for "env"). Write-only: never stored in Terraform state. Encrypted locally before it ever reaches the server / the vault file. Changes are detected by decrypting the stored ciphertext during plan and comparing.

### Optional

- `group` (String) Full path of the group this secret lives in, e.g. "acme-corp/engineering". Required in API mode, forbidden in local vault mode (a local vault is one flat list of secrets, no subgroups).
- `notes` (String) Notes, encrypted together with the value. Write-only, like "value".
- `url` (String)
- `username` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Secret ID — server-assigned UUID in API mode, a random local ID in local vault mode.
- `updated_at` (String) Server-side last modification time (API mode). Null in local vault mode. Becomes unknown in the plan whenever the secret will be rewritten, including when only the write-only value differs.
